annotations.title: Email a payment request to its client

description: Email (or re-email) an open payment request to its named client: the amount, due date, note, the signed pay link, and the bank details when the request carries them. Sent from the merchant via GoCushy with replies going to the merchant's inbox. Use after create_payment_request without send_email, or when the client says they lost the email. Refuses (422) a paid or withdrawn request — emailing a settled bill is a false statement with the merchant's name on it.
name: send_payment_request
title: Email a payment request to its client
